title: PIPseq Pipeline - Single-sample multiple-target-depths downsampling workflow
description: Downsamples one already-processed sample's GEX molecule-info and gRNA AnnData to several target depths, optionally runs a GEX sequencing-saturation sweep, and combines the results across depths into one AnnData

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_files.description: All of the sample's DRAGEN scRNA output + gRNA AnnData files, in any order
input_files.help_text: The molecule-info h5, filtered-barcodes list, and scRNA_metrics.csv (required when --run_gex_downsample is true), the optional features.tsv.gz (only for a combined GEX+CRISPR molecule_info_h5), and the CRISPR guide-capture AnnData .h5ad (required when --run_crispr_downsample is true). Each file's role is auto-detected from its DRAGEN filename suffix -- see helpMessage()/CLAUDE.md -- so files can be selected together in any order.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved

batch_basename.help_text: Only meaningful for downsample.nf's batch runs -- declared here purely because nextflow.config sets a config-parse-time default for it (used to key pipeline_info/ report paths before any entrypoint-specific param is available), and nf-schema warns about any params.* set outside the schema.

downsample_options.title: Downsample options
downsample_options.description: Parameters controlling single-sample multi-depth downsampling and combining

run_combine.description: Whether to combine downsampled GEX+gRNA across depths into one AnnData
run_combine.help_text: Requires both --run_gex_downsample and --run_crispr_downsample to be true.

gex_target_depths.description: One or more GEX target reads/cell depths
gex_target_depths.help_text: Required when --run_gex_downsample is true. One downsampled matrix is written per depth.

crispr_target_depths.description: One or more gRNA target reads/cell depths
crispr_target_depths.help_text: Required when --run_crispr_downsample is true. One downsampled AnnData is written per depth.

run_saturation.description: Also run a GEX sequencing-saturation sweep
run_saturation.help_text: Requires --run_gex_downsample. Writes saturation.csv (median transcripts/genes and % sequencing saturation across a depth ladder) alongside the downsampled GEX matrices.

saturation_extra_depths.description: Extra reads-per-cell depths to include in the saturation sweep, beyond the script's built-in ladder

gex_matrix_format.description: Which GEX matrix layout(s) to write per depth
gex_matrix_format.help_text: "raw" writes the full unfiltered barcode matrix, "filtered" only the cells in the DRAGEN filtered-barcodes list, "both" writes both under raw_matrix/ and filtered_matrix/ subdirs of each <depth>rpc/ folder. --run_combine reads the filtered layout, so it cannot be used with "raw".

min_reads_per_cell.description: Floor below which a requested depth is dropped

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images used to execute pipeline processes.

qc_container.help_text: Image used by every process in this workflow.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Resource allocation options for pipeline processes.

cpu_downsample_molecule_info.description: Number of CPUs for the DOWNSAMPLE_MOLECULE_INFO process

memory_gb_downsample_molecule_info.description: Memory in GB for the DOWNSAMPLE_MOLECULE_INFO process

cpu_downsample_crispr_anndata.description: Number of CPUs for the DOWNSAMPLE_CRISPR_ANNDATA process

memory_gb_downsample_crispr_anndata.description: Memory in GB for the DOWNSAMPLE_CRISPR_ANNDATA process

cpu_combine_downsampled_depths.description: Number of CPUs for the COMBINE_DOWNSAMPLED_DEPTHS process

memory_gb_combine_downsampled_depths.description: Memory in GB for the COMBINE_DOWNSAMPLED_DEPTHS process

cpu_summarize_gex_downsample_targets.description: Unused by this entrypoint (only relevant to downsample.nf's batch runs)

memory_gb_summarize_gex_downsample_targe.description: Unused by this entrypoint (only relevant to downsample.nf's batch runs)
